notes.title: 1.0.4 'New Year' Update
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30765746/d1c2513e0d0c3b23b03ffd910329f2bbcbb7843a.png

Update ver 1.0.4 (EA)
Melon Seed Edition

Happy New Year to all! This update introduces a number of changes that affect the feel and style of the game, including standardising the UI design and introducing ambient background music. It also introduces a new multiplayer minigame, the first of its kind, as well as an early starting point for NPCs. 

EDIT:  Following the 1.0.4 update, two serious bugs were found related to the introduction of new features. Please make sure you are using "rev 2" of the 1.0.4 update (version no. appears on the main menu at the top right).

New content ːprotoheartː

 New multiplayer minigame: Connect! Play the classic game of four-in-a-row with a friend, or against a bot!
 Rudimentary NPC system implemented: NPCs can be spawned and will walk about. This is a rudimentary implementation, and NPC behaviour will become more complex in a future patch.
 Badges, trading cards, emoticons, and Steam profile backgrounds now available!
 New ambient background music plays in-game
 New character face: evil robotic head.

Changes ːprintplasmaː

 New music for main menu and connection interface
 Standardised fonts in the game
 Multiple UI changes to standardise window design

Notable Bug fixes ːplaceboː

 Building demolish button being accessible when no building is available
 Client crash in some cases when connecting to freshly created lobbies
 Tab window appearing over minigames

notes.title: Winter Progress
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30765746/e50a5a452b63add7799b3d6f88e4d99e75271d40.png

We were hoping to have an update ready at this time, but version 1.0.4 is taking a little longer to get right, due to the introduction of some multiplayer minigames that need some extra work. The next update will also introduce UI and music changes, and NPCs will be working again. 


Trading Cards and Badges
You can now collect ProtoMasons trading cards, emoticons, profile backgrounds, and badges in Steam! My personal favourite is the heart emoticon. ːprotoheartː

Trading cards can be earned by playing ProtoMasons.


Christmas Holiday
Many parts of the world celebrate Christmas this month, in a variety of different ways! I've personally added some Christmas content to the Workshop for our own 'Christmas House' world which will be hosted 24/7 for the next week or so. Come along and build a house of your own!


- Jargoons, main dev

notes.title: ProtoMasons 1.0.3 Update
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30765746/d1910e569a07bcbb847a68ee8c4896ec0916d225.png
Update ver 1.0.3 (EA)
Melon Seed Edition

This patch fixes some bugs, but also introduces changes to the main menu and solo mode. 

New content:

 Three new avatar faces: surreal heads.
 Added town to the background of the grassland map

Changes:

 Removed solo mode temporarily (please see below for more details)
 Play menu now has two buttons for creating world and joining world
 Main menu 'Host' button changed to 'News', which links to hub announcements in Steam overlay
 Temporarily disabled "broken furniture" until repair tool is available

Bug fixes:

 'Needs' hunger glitch caused by a side-effect of the 1.0.2 patch
 Loud volume of the text sound (as per request)
 Cloud generation in all weather events to address some performance issues
 Snow appearing indoors
 "disease_cleanse" crash on host
 Crash when attempting to disconnect from server while textures are loading


Solo Mode Disabled
Solo mode is an experimental single player mode in ProtoMasons. It is unfinished, and was included as a bonus feature to be experimented with. Unfortunately, based on some the dialogue and feedback with customers thus far, a number of people have mistaken solo mode for the "main game" or have taken it to be representative of the quality and stability of the overall product, which is not the case. At this time, the decision has been made to disable access to solo mode indefinitely, to prevent future confusion, and to prioritise development on the original online concept.

notes.title: 1.0.2 Update Notes
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30765746/d1910e569a07bcbb847a68ee8c4896ec0916d225.png
Update ver 1.0.2 (EA)
Melon Seed Edition

This is an important update that includes crucial fixes to a number of bugs.

Changes:

Teleporter speed increased
Corrected optimisation oversight for storm weather clouds, which caused heavy framerate drop on modest GPUs

Bug fixes:

Fixed major issue which caused player Steam ID corruption (this should solve a number of sync issues)
Fixed problem that caused animations to end prematurely (or not run) on other players
Fixed glitch that caused players to appear in the background after joining
Fixed issue that occurs when joining a server, that causes the other players to first appear at the start of the map, then teleport away
Fixed desync issue (related to sitting) that caused players to appear inside when they were outside and vice versa (possibly the 'invisibility' glitch reported in reviews)
Fixed object pickup crashing game on certain items 
Fixed glitch that caused outside objects to spawn indoors when another player is building outside
Fixed glitch that caused thirst extend above 100% when rejoining a server
Fixed body scanner sound looping endlessly if scanner is prematurely exited
Fixed food items always appearing outside at full visibility when eaten


With thanks to Luigi and Sentry for submitting extra details that helped diagnose the issues fixed in this update.
